close_reason: Changed MtaStsEnforcer::new() to return Self; callers wrap in Arc at their discretion
description: relay_client.rs:47: MtaStsEnforcer::new() returns Arc<Self> breaking the Rust convention that new() returns Self. Callers cannot store a bare MtaStsEnforcer. Idiomatic rewrite: return Self from new(), let callers wrap in Arc::new() at their discretion. The current design forces Arc allocation even in tests that don't need sharing.
title: MtaStsEnforcer::new() returns Arc<Self> instead of Self
